# Velo University

> > Evidence-based baseball and softball training combining biomechanics, sports psychology, and strength conditioning to optimize pitching performance and prevent injuries.

Velo University (VeloU) offers remote and on-site training programs led by Dr. Nick Serio and Paul Franzese, emphasizing research-backed approaches to velocity development, arm care, and mental performance. The platform integrates advanced technology with personalized coaching for pitchers, position players, and softball athletes.

## Key Topics

- Pitching biomechanics
- Injury prevention
- Elbow stress reduction
- Velocity training
- Mental toughness
- Arm care protocols
- Strength and conditioning
- Tommy John recovery
- Throwing mechanics
- Sports psychology
- Connective tissue training
- Pitching command (2-by-3 strategy)
- Youth athlete development
- Remote coaching technology
- Evidence-based training

## Training Programs & Services

- [On-Site Pitching & Strength Training in NY | VeloU](https://www.velouniversity.com/on-site-training): In-person training at VeloU facility with testing and advanced technology
- [Softball Mental Mastery - Master the Mental Side of Softball - VeloU](https://www.velouniversity.com/courses/softball-mental-mastery): 8-hour course by Cassie Reilly-Boccia on softball mental toughness
- [VeloU Parents Onboarding](https://www.velouniversity.com/parents-briefing): Parent guide to VeloU app setup, training structure, and progress tracking

## Pitching Biomechanics & Injury Prevention

- [Why Stride Length Might Be the Most Underrated Variable in Your Delivery](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/why-stride-length-might-be-the-most-underrated-variable-in-your-delivery): Dr. Nick Serio on stride length's impact on velocity and elbow stress
- [Towel Drills & Elbow Stress: What the Data Actually Says](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/towel-drills-elbow-stress-what-the-data-actually-says-o8txg): Dr. Nick Serio analyzes research showing towel drills generate 80% elbow stress
- [Year One Lies: Why Post-UCLR Pitchers Look 'Back' But Aren't — And What Really Signals the Comeback](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/year-one-lies-why-post-uclr-pitchers-look-back-but-arent----and-what-really-signals-the-comeback): Dr. Nick Serio on Tommy John recovery metrics and off-speed spin rates
- [The Art of Communication: How Discussing Mechanics Can Affect Athlete Performance](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/the-art-of-communication-how-discussing-mechanics-can-affect-athlete-performance): Dr. Nick Serio on effective coaching communication and athlete feedback

## Strength Training & Athletic Development

- [Building Bulletproof Connective Tissues: What Really Stimulates Tendon and Ligament Growth](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/tendon-ligament-growth-training): Paul Franzese on eccentric loading, BFR, and connective tissue training
- [When Should Young Athletes Start Weight Training?](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/young-athletes-weight-training): Paul Franzese on NSCA guidelines for youth strength training timing
- [Understanding the Importance of Muscle Fascia](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/importance-of-muscle-fascia): Paul Franzese on fascia's role in force transfer and athletic performance

## Mental Performance & Sports Psychology

- [Why Positive Visualization Isn't Enough: The Hidden Power of Negative Imagery in the Yips](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/why-positive-visualization-isnt-enough-the-hidden-power-of-negative-imagery-in-the-yips): PLOS ONE study reveals negative imagery's role in throwing yips recovery
- [Reframing Willpower: Harnessing Unlimited Potential](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/unlimited-willpower): Mental training strategies to reframe willpower as unlimited resource

## Pitching Strategy & Remote Training

- [2 by 3! The Key to Dominance in Remote Pitching Training](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/remote-pitching-coaching-2-by-3-dominance): Paul Franzese on mastering 2 strikes in 3 pitches with remote coaching
- [2 By 3! Improve pitching control with online training](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/2-by-3-improve-pitching-control-with-online-training): Sam Byrns on 2-by-3 strategy for pitching command and ERA reduction
- [Is VeloU Just For Pitchers?](https://www.velouniversity.com/post/is-velou-just-for-pitchers): Dr. Nick Serio explains VeloU training for position players and catchers
